## Attendance

The programme board met in April 2026. Present were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, A. Okonkwo, K. Lindqvist. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting.

The board confirmed the attendance recorded above and proceeded with the scheduled review of programme performance and routine business.

## Performance

The board reviewed performance for April 2026. There were 2524 captures during the month. The outstanding grader backlog was 318, and the number of letter breaches was 42.

The board noted these figures and agreed that they should continue to be monitored through the established programme reporting arrangements. No further performance issues were recorded in the minutes.

## Items

Routine business was considered. No additional items were raised for discussion, and the board did not record any changes to the current programme position.

## Actions

Actions already identified will be carried forward to the next meeting. The board will continue to monitor captures, the grader backlog and letter breaches as part of its routine review.
